title: SKILLER: Language-Level Reinforcement Learning for Reusable Skill Extraction in Small Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2608.10538v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Agent skills represent a standardized format for packaging procedural knowledge and domain expertise, serving within agent harness systems as an essential mechanism to continually constrain a language model's behavior space for repeatable, high-quality task execution. However, because strong closed-source models entail high inference costs, current popular agent harnesses, such as Codex and OpenClaw, remain prohibitively expensive when deploying these skills to accomplish real-world tasks. The rapid capability enhancement of open-source models deployable on consumer-grade GPUs presents a compelling opportunity to drastically reduce these costs by leveraging skill-based behavioral constraints. translated_title: SKILLER：面向小语言模型中可复用技能提取的语言级强化学习
translated_abstract: 摘要：arXiv:2608.10538v2 公告类型：替换 摘要：智能体技能代表了一种标准化格式，用于封装程序性知识和领域专长，在智能体框架系统中作为一种关键机制，持续约束语言模型的行为空间，以实现可重复、高质量的任务执行。然而，由于强大的闭源模型推理成本高昂，当前流行的智能体框架（如Codex和OpenClaw）在部署这些技能完成现实世界任务时仍过于昂贵。可在消费级GPU上部署的开源模型能力快速增强，为通过利用基于技能的行为约束大幅降低这些成本提供了诱人的机会。尽管如此，为这类紧凑模型自动生成有效技能仍是一项重大的实际挑战。为解决此问题，我们提出了SKILLER，一种自然语言驱动的强化学习框架，专为小语言模型设计。
tldr: 本文提出SKILLER，一种自然语言驱动的强化学习框架，旨在为小语言模型自动提取可复用技能，以降低部署成本并提升任务执行效率。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes SKILLER, a natural-language-driven reinforcement learning framework designed to automatically extract reusable skills for small language models, reducing deployment costs and improving task execution efficiency.
